IAS Officer Divya Mittal Resigns After 11 Years of Service

IAS officer Divya Mittal has resigned from her post after 11 years of service. Mittal, who studied at IIT and IIM, had previously left a high-paying job in London for the UPSC civil services. While she served in multiple districts and important positions, her farewell message specifically mentioned Deoria and Mirzapur. One report notes that her resignation raises questions about the conflict between honest officers and the political system, citing examples of other officers who faced difficulties.
